text:
Sarah (Sales): FYI Monarch Health is asking whether we can run a POC with their custom 'monarch-13b-v1' variant. They want to validate generation quality and latency. Sales asked me to confirm catalog fit + security checklist before we give a firm pricing & timeline.
Alex (Solutions): What format is the model? HF tar? GGUF? Any custom ops/LM head? Need model size, vocab, and whether it's been quantized. Also what's KV cache layout — standard llama-ish?
Sarah (Sales): They said it's a HF bundle + custom tokenizer, no custom CUDA ops. 13B dense, not quantized. They've agreed to share a link to the artifact once we sign the NDA addendum.
Miguel (Infra): If it's standard HuggingFace/transformers 4.x weights we should be fine. Quick checks: sequence length expected? kv-cache compatible? Also need to know activation types (rmsnorm vs layernorm). If it's rmsnorm we have earlier patches but need to run a model-convert smoke test.
Alex (Solutions): I can run a compatibility pass. Can someone upload the artifact or grant a pre-signed URL? Command I'll run: `curl -s -X POST https://internal-tools/compat-check -d '{"model_url":"<url>","target":"rw-inference"}' | jq`
Priya (Security): Heads-up on enterprise blockers: they require KMS integration (customer-managed keys), audit logs for inference calls, and SOC2-ready attestations. Also they asked about data residency (EU). We should confirm whether POC infra can be isolated in their VPC or if we need Dedicated.
Jenna (EngOps): We can offer a private deployment in eu-west with customer KMS and audit retention. For POC timelines — if no custom kernels, we can spin up a sandbox in ~3d. If we need dedicated GPU reservation, pricing estimate: ~$1200/day for a single A100-equivalent node; I'll calc exact later.
Miguel (Infra): Quick note: quantization path is important for cost. If they accept q4_0 or q4_k_m, we can reduce footprint ~40%. For the smoke test I'll need a sample prompt and some model artifact to run token-level perf. Sarah ping me when URL available.
Sarah (Sales): @Priya can you confirm the minimum security items we need for the NDA addendum and the questionnaire? Also cc @Jenna — client expects an answer on whether PII will be logged during POC.
Priya (Security): Minimum: KMS+HSM option, audit logs, RBAC for customer tokens, and an attestation quote. For PII: by default we treat POC logs as ephemeral and can disable storage; I'll draft a line for the MSA addendum. :+1:
Alex (Solutions): Putting checklist into one place: 1) model artifact URL 2) tokenizer + sample prompts 3) target latency SLO 4) desired capacity (concurrency) 5) security q's answered. I'll make a quick runbook and share link.
DeployBot: Preflight runbook created: https://internal/wiki/monarch-poc-runbook (created by @alex.solutions).
Sarah (Sales): Great — I'll ask the customer to push artifact and sample prompts. Tentative next step: run compatibility tests (Miguel/Alex), security sign-off (Priya), then pricing stub from Jenna. ETA next week. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
